evidence_policy.official_statistics: Can establish market scale or activity, not willingness to pay.
evidence_policy.official_vendor: Can establish category features and published prices, not AXIGNAL demand.
evidence_policy.primary_interview: Required to validate buyer workflow, budget, failure cost and purchase criteria.
evidence_policy.paid_event: Required later; not produced in P01.

sources.title: Public Procurement, Trade and Industrial Policies
supports: Public procurement averages about 13% of GDP across OECD countries.
Procurement is strategically linked to industrial policy and supply-chain resilience.

sources.title: Stotles pricing
supports: Public-sector sales and bid workflows are sold as connected products.
Published starting prices include Growth sales at £475/month, Growth bid at £495/month, and combined Growth at £873/month.
Bid workflow includes qualification, projects, content library and AI-assisted responses.

sources.title: Tenderlake pricing
supports: European plan is advertised at £546/month or £396/month paid annually.
Workflow includes stage tracking, qualifying-out reasons, bid-interest coordination, alerts, API and team distribution.

sources.title: Mercell supplier platform
supports: Supplier proposition combines discovery, market intelligence and structured bid delivery.
Free portals are positioned as producing noise and fragmented work.

sources.title: Horizon Europe
supports: Horizon Europe is a major multi-year research and innovation funding programme with an indicative 2021–2027 budget around €93.5 billion after the mid-term review.

sources.title: Instrumentl product overview
supports: Grant products compete as full-lifecycle operating systems, not only search databases.
The workflow spans finding, writing, management, collaboration, deadlines, tasks, spend and performance reporting.

sources.title: Candid pricing
supports: Published entry pricing starts at $1,199 billed annually for funder/nonprofit research products.
Buyer value includes prospect research, organisation data and contact context.

sources.title: Pivot-RP
supports: Research institutions buy global funding discovery with workflow and intelligence tools.
Vendor states use by more than 700 research institutions.

sources.title: Regology pricing
supports: Professional regulatory-change access is advertised at $1,700 per user per month on a three-year contract.
Enterprise includes global jurisdictions, workflows, compliance management, dashboards and GRC integrations.
Regulatory intelligence buyers pay for operational impact assessment and implementation workflows, not alerts alone.

sources.title: Regology platform
supports: The product maps regulatory content to requirements, risks, controls, policies, tasks and reporting.
Buyer workflow starts with applicable content and continues through operational compliance.

sources.title: Forecasting infrastructure investment needs through 2040
supports: The referenced outlook estimated global infrastructure investment needs of $94 trillion through 2040, or $97 trillion including selected SDG needs.
Infrastructure opportunity discovery is geographically and lifecycle intensive.

sources.title: Construction Projects intelligence
supports: GlobalData advertises end-to-end construction-project lifecycle tracking from announcement to completion.
Project stage, participants, contacts and key dates are central sales-development outputs.

sources.title: AlphaSense pricing
supports: Market-intelligence pricing is sales-led rather than self-serve.
Product combines external and internal content, monitoring, research, work products and enterprise controls.
Vendor reports more than 7,000 enterprise customers and more than 500 million documents.

sources.title: AlphaSense platform
supports: Corporate intelligence workflows include deep research, monitoring, internal-content integration, work products and scheduled agents.
Persistent work products and internal knowledge are important switching-cost drivers.

sources.title: Macrobond data
supports: Macroeconomic research buyers require governed structured data, metadata, discovery and human quality processes.
Vendor states more than 300 million time series.

sources.title: Macrobond workflow
supports: Macroeconomic products compete on an end-to-end research workflow from question to chart and distribution.
Vendor advertises a searchable library of more than 2,400 global sources.

sources.title: World Trade Statistics 2025
supports: World trade in goods and commercial services reached $34.89 trillion in 2025.
Trade intelligence operates across large, changing bilateral and sectoral flows.

sources.title: Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence
supports: Supply-chain buyers use trade data to identify partners, monitor competitors and detect investment or sourcing signals.
The platform combines entity resolution, machine learning, visual analytics, alerts and exportable results.

sources.title: World Energy Investment 2026
supports: Global energy investment is expected to reach about $3.4 trillion in 2026, including about $2.2 trillion in clean energy.
Energy opportunity intelligence must connect projects, policy, capital, technology and geography.

sources.title: Lens
supports: Energy intelligence platforms combine global asset, market, company, cost, scenario and geospatial data.
Buyer tasks include screening, benchmarking, valuation, risk assessment and opportunity identification.

sources.title: How Rystad Energy delivers value
supports: Rystad Energy positions its offer around data, analytics, research and decision support.
Trusted analytical products and workflow access are category expectations for professional energy intelligence.

sources.title: World Intellectual Property Indicators 2025 — patents
supports: About 3.7 million patent applications were filed worldwide in 2024.
Global innovation intelligence requires deduplication, family lineage, legal status and multilingual search.

sources.title: OECD R&D statistical release 2026
supports: OECD estimated global R&D expenditure may have reached $3.8 trillion in 2024.
Innovation buyers operate in a very large and fast-changing evidence environment.

sources.title: Patsnap Eureka platform and pricing
supports: Patsnap Eureka advertises a self-serve Pro plan at $200/month and an enterprise plan with shared workspaces, team projects, administration and role-based permissions.
The platform provides domain-specific agents and workflows for IP, R&D, life sciences and materials.

sources.title: Patsnap Analytics
supports: Patent analytics includes search, analysis, monitoring and a cross-team workspace.
Users can index patents, vote on relevance and assign tasks in a central collaboration surface.

sources.title: Patsnap Open Platform pricing
supports: The Open Platform uses usage-based credits and advertises Pro from $100.
Enterprise offers custom throughput, SSO and sub-organisation controls.
